action: Activate Phase 07B-R3 for the bounded JWKS refresh-concurrency repair
reason: A monotonic atomic refresh generation lets queued callers reuse a completed forced refresh instead of creating another network cycle while preserving the existing lock, pinned manager and fail-closed validation.
constraints: No trust, endpoint, cache, retry, package, logging or external-state change.
A coalesced caller validates once against the current manager with refreshOnKeyMiss=false.
A fresh manager is published only after initialization produces a non-Unavailable result.
Concurrent invalid, rotated-valid, refresh-failure and cancellation regressions are required.
